en.why: The seven layers share one axis with identical x and y and are spaced only on z, so the viewer reads one phone lifting apart and settling back together. They do not move as a block: the separation starts are staggered across 1.0–1.32s and each layer eases with expo.out over 1.7s, fast first and slow at the end; closing runs in the reverse order, back glass first and cover glass last, with a 1.05s cubic in-out, a different rhythm from the separation, so it reads as assembly. The camera tilts to 72° while the layers separate so the gaps between them show; to see the board, the cover glass, display and frame first fade and rise 100px and only then does the camera dive in, so nothing above the board blocks it. Callouts arrive one at a time, 0.3s apart, and each leader end is re-projected every frame to its part's current position, so it stays attached while the part rises; the callout text matches what is printed on the parts (A1 · 3NM · 8-CORE on the chip lid, 3,890 mAh on the battery label). The callouts fade 4.1–4.5s and the cover glass waits until 4.35s to rise. Every layer is drawn with edge thickness and real detail (traces, chips and raised packages on the board, a label and orange pull tabs on the battery, copper on the coil), so the close-up on the board holds up. There is one accent color, amber #f5b04a.
spec: Film 11.8s. Fade in from black 0–0.9s; the seven layers start separating 1.0–1.32s (cover glass 1.0s, back glass 1.05s, display 1.1s, coil 1.14s, frame 1.2s, battery 1.26s, logic board 1.32s), each over 1.7s; camera tilts to 72° by 2.9s; three callouts appear at 2.7s, 3.0s and 3.3s (leaders draw over 0.7s) and fade 4.1–4.5s; cover glass, display and frame fade out (0.55s) and rise 100px from 4.35s, 4.45s and 4.55s; camera dives into the logic board 4.6–5.4s, holds on it until 6.9s and pulls out 6.9–7.65s; the three layers fade back from 7.3s, 7.4s and 7.5s (0.5s); the seven layers close from the back glass to the cover glass 7.55–9.14s, each over 1.05s; lockup mark at 8.4s, name at 8.5s, tagline at 8.75s; highlight 9.0–10.3s; held to the end at 11.8s

Separation expo.out (1.7s); closing cubic in-out (1.05s, the power3.inOut curve); camera tilt, azimuth, dolly and pan use monotone cubic interpolation between keyframes with no overshoot; the glass, display and frame fade and rise, callout fade-in and leader draw use smoothstep; mark, name and tagline expo.out; fade from black power1.out

CSS 3D stage with perspective 2400px; tilt is rotateX (0° faces the screen) and azimuth is rotateZ. Tilt: 46° over 0–0.9s, 72° at 2.9s, 70° at 4.6s, 50° at 5.2s, 46° at 5.8s, 42° at 6.9s, 54° at 7.4s, 48° at 8.4s, 36° at 9.0s, 16° at 10.2s, 15° to the end. Azimuth: −36° at 0s, −38° at 2.9s, −62° at 4.6s, −24° at 5.4s, −10° at 6.0s, +5° at 6.9s, −14° at 7.4s, −26° at 8.4s, −8° at 10.2s. Dolly (negative pulls back): 0 at 0.9s, −230px at 2.9s, −120px at 4.6s, +1250px at 5.4s, +1400px at 5.9s (about 2.4x), +1000px at 6.9s, +250px at 7.25s, −200px at 7.65s, −100px at 9.0s, 0 at 10.2s. The orbit pivot moves from the centre of the stack to the chip on the logic board (x 93, y 93, z 80) over 4.6–5.4s, drifts to (200, 213, −20) over 5.6–6.9s, releases over 6.9–7.3s and is back at the centre by 8.1s. The phone slides right: −34px at 2.9s, 0 at 5.4s, +380px at 8.2s, +420px at 8.9s and held

Seven phone layers, each 360x756px with 52px corners, moved only on z: cover glass, display (lock screen 9:41), metal frame, logic board, battery, wireless coil and back glass, top to bottom. Closed z is 21, 14, 9, 4, 4, −6, −9px; open z is 420, 300, 180, 80, −20, −110, −210px. Each layer has 1–7 copies stacked 2px apart behind it for edge thickness (cover glass 3, display 2, frame 7, board 2, battery 4, coil 1, back 3). The board is a dark green PCB with gold traces, 11 chips and 5 raised packages, the A1 package being 100x100px with an 86x86px lid; the battery is 300x344px printed 3,890 mAh with two orange pull tabs; the coil is 12 turns of copper; the back glass has three 48px lenses. While open, the layers underneath carry a shade of 0.16–0.58 opacity. An 800x1200px radial shadow sits under the phone at z=−300px. Three callouts: Cover glass (01 ceramic · 0.6 mm, pointing at the lower right corner of the glass, text on the right), Arden A1 chip (02 3 nm · 8-core CPU, pointing at the chip, text on the left) and 3,890 mAh battery (03 silicon-carbon · 15.0 Wh, pointing at the battery's right edge, text on the right)

Each callout's leader end is re-projected every frame to its part's current z, so it stays attached while the part rises; callout text matches what is printed on the parts (A1 · 3NM · 8-CORE on the chip lid, 3,890 mAh on the battery label, Battery health 100% · 3,890 mAh in the lock-screen notification); all callouts are gone by 4.5s and the cover glass only starts to rise at 4.35s, so a leader never sits on a moving glass; as the cover glass, display and frame fade, the shade they cast on the layers below clears with them, so the board is bright in the close-up; the layers close from the back glass up and the cover glass lands last, and when the mark appears at 8.4s the phone has already slid about 390px to the right, leaving the left side for the lockup; the 9.0s highlight and the 9.06s settle land as the last two layers close (9.02s and 9.14s)

Background #09090b with a radial gradient (#2a2d37 → #171920 → #0b0b0e, centred at 58% and 40% of the frame), a 10% amber glow at the upper left and a 7% blue glow at the lower right that shift with the azimuth; one accent amber #f5b04a; callout title Inter 600 32px white, subtitle JetBrains Mono 20px at 70% white, number in amber; leader 1.6px with a 4.5px dot and a 9px halo at 22%; mark an 88px amber rounded square, name Arden One in Inter 600 156px with -0.045em tracking, tagline 40px #9b9ca4; grain at 7% opacity re-rolled every 3 frames and a vignette reaching 58% at the edges
en.prompt: Build an 11.8-second, 1920x1080, 30 fps dark product film called Exploded View Animation for a fictional product, Arden One (a phone). The background is a radial gradient (centre #2a2d37, through #171920 to #0b0b0e at the edges, base #09090b), the only accent color is amber #f5b04a, the font is Inter and callout subtitles use JetBrains Mono. Use CSS 3D: a stage with perspective 2400px and one rig container that acts as the camera (translate3d, rotateX for tilt, rotateZ for azimuth). Inside it stack seven phone layers on one axis, each 360x756px with 52px corners, and from then on change only each layer's translateZ. Top to bottom: cover glass (a thin bright border), display (a lock screen in a dark blue-violet to orange gradient with the time 9:41, Thursday, 26 November, and a notification Arden Care / Battery health 100% · 3,890 mAh), metal frame (screw bosses, antenna breaks), logic board (dark green PCB, gold traces, 11 chips, a raised A1 chip package of 100x100px whose lid is printed ARDEN A1 3NM · 8-CORE, plus a modem, a shield can and a connector), battery (light grey metal, printed 3,890 mAh and Li-ion polymer · 3.87 V · 15.0 Wh, with two orange pull tabs), wireless coil (a ferrite plate with 12 turns of copper) and back glass (three lenses of 48px). Give each layer 1–7 copies stacked 2px apart behind it for edge thickness and lay an 800x1200px radial shadow under the phone at z=-300px. Closed, the seven layers sit at z 21, 14, 9, 4, 4, -6, -9px; open, at 420, 300, 180, 80, -20, -110, -210px. While open, the layers underneath carry a shade of 0.16–0.58 opacity, but only while layers above cover them. Timeline: fade in from black 0–0.9s; the layers start separating between 1.0s and 1.32s (cover glass 1.0, back glass 1.05, display 1.1, coil 1.14, frame 1.2, battery 1.26, board 1.32), each over 1.7s with expo.out. The camera tilt goes from 46° to 72° over 0.9–2.9s, the azimuth from -36° to -38° and the dolly back to -230px. Three SVG callouts with leader lines (a 1.6px amber line, a 4.5px solid dot with a 9px translucent halo, a 60px slanted kink and then a horizontal run): at 2.7s Cover glass (01 ceramic · 0.6 mm, pointing at the lower right corner of the glass, text on the right), at 3.0s Arden A1 chip (02 3 nm · 8-core CPU, pointing at the chip, text on the left) and at 3.3s 3,890 mAh battery (03 silicon-carbon · 15.0 Wh, pointing at the battery's right edge, text on the right). Each leader draws over 0.7s, the title is 32px 600 white, the subtitle 20px monospace and the number amber; re-project each leader's end to its part's current z every frame; fade all three out over 4.1–4.5s. At 4.35s, 4.45s and 4.55s the cover glass, display and frame fade out one after another (0.55s) and rise 100px, and the shade they cast on the layers below clears with them. From 4.6 to 5.4s the camera dives into the board: move the orbit pivot to the chip (x 93, y 93, z 80), tilt 50°, azimuth -24°, push the dolly to +1250px, reach +1400px at 5.9s (about 2.4x), hold on the board until 6.9s while the pivot drifts to (200, 213, -20), then pull out to -200px by 7.65s. The three top layers fade back and drop at 7.3s, 7.4s and 7.5s (0.5s). From 7.55s the seven layers close from the back glass to the cover glass, each over 1.05s with cubic in-out (starts 7.55, 7.63, 7.71, 7.79, 7.87, 7.97, 8.09), finished at 9.14s. Interpolate the camera values between keyframes with a monotone cubic so nothing overshoots. Slide the phone 420px right over 8.2–8.9s; from 8.4s the lockup comes in with expo.out: an 88px amber rounded-square mark, at 8.5s Arden One (156px, 600, -0.045em tracking) and at 8.75s the tagline Built from the inside out. (40px, #9b9ca4). A highlight sweeps the cover glass over 9.0–10.3s, the camera gives a 16px settle from 9.06s, the tilt eases to 16° and holds to the end. Finish with 7% grain re-rolled every 3 frames and a vignette.
says: The parts of the phone hang in the air one layer at a time with gaps between them
Leader lines point at the chip and the battery and give their specs
The glass fades, the camera drops onto the board and pulls out, and the parts close back into the phone
vs: X-ray Dissolve cross-dissolves the inner structure into the outer shell from one camera position and the parts never leave their place; Exploded View Animation pulls the parts apart along one axis so each layer shows on its own, then puts them back together.

Macro Pull-out Reveal stays at extreme close range and ends on one pull-back to the whole device; here the device itself splits into seven layers, the camera dives into the board and pulls out, and the layers then close.

zh.why: 七层零件共用同一条轴，x、y 完全对齐，只在 z 方向拉开间距，所以观众看到的是一台手机原样向上分开、再原样合回去。七层不同时动：分开时起步时间错开在 1.0–1.32s 之内，每层用 1.7s 的 expo.out，先快后慢；合拢时顺序反过来，从后盖到盖板，用 1.05s 的三次方缓入缓出，节奏和分开时不同，读起来是装配。镜头在分开时倾到 72°，层与层之间的缝能看清；要看主板，盖板、显示屏和中框先淡出并上升 100px，镜头再冲进去，主板不会被上面几层挡住。标注一次出现一个，间隔 0.3s，引线端点每帧按所指零件当前的位置重新投影，零件上升时引线不脱开；标注文字和零件上印的字一致（芯片盖面的 A1 · 3NM · 8-CORE，电池标签上的 3,890 mAh）。标注 4.1–4.5s 淡出，盖板等到 4.35s 才开始上升。每层都画了边缘厚度和真实细节：主板有走线、芯片和凸起的封装，电池有标签和橙色拉条，线圈是铜线，所以冲进主板的近景也经得住看。全片只用一个强调色琥珀 #f5b04a。
spec: 全片 11.8s。黑场淡入 0–0.9s；七层 1.0–1.32s 依次开始分开（盖板 1.0s、后盖 1.05s、显示屏 1.1s、线圈 1.14s、中框 1.2s、电池 1.26s、主板 1.32s），每层 1.7s；镜头 0.9–2.9s 倾到 72°；三个标注 2.7s、3.0s、3.3s 出现（引线 0.7s 画出），4.1–4.5s 淡出；盖板、显示屏、中框 4.35s、4.45s、4.55s 起淡出（0.55s）并上升 100px；镜头 4.6–5.4s 冲进主板，停在主板上到 6.9s，6.9–7.65s 拉出；三层 7.3s、7.4s、7.5s 起淡回（0.5s）；七层 7.55–9.14s 从后盖到盖板依次合拢，每层 1.05s；字标 8.4s 起，字标文字 8.5s，标语 8.75s；高光 9.0–10.3s，保持到片尾 11.8s
分开 expo.out（1.7s）；合拢三次方缓入缓出（1.05s，power3.inOut 的曲线）；镜头倾角、方位、推拉和平移在关键帧之间用单调三次插值，不过冲；盖板、显示屏、中框淡出和上升、标注淡入和引线用 smoothstep；字标、字标文字、标语 expo.out；黑场淡入 power1.out

手机七层，每层 360x756px、圆角 52px，只改 z：自上而下盖板玻璃、显示屏（锁屏 9:41）、金属中框、主板、电池、无线充电线圈、后盖。闭合 z 为 21、14、9、4、4、−6、−9px，展开 z 为 420、300、180、80、−20、−110、−210px。每层后面叠 1–7 层相距 2px 的复制层做边缘厚度（盖板 3、显示屏 2、中框 7、主板 2、电池 4、线圈 1、后盖 3）。主板是深绿 PCB 加金色走线，11 颗芯片和 5 块凸起的封装，其中 A1 芯片封装 100x100px、盖面 86x86px；电池 300x344px，印 3,890 mAh 和两条橙色拉条；线圈是 12 圈铜线；后盖有三个直径 48px 的镜头。展开时下面各层按 0.16–0.58 的不透明度加阴影。手机下方 z=−300px 放一块 800x1200px 的径向暗影。标注三个：Cover glass（01 ceramic · 0.6 mm，指向盖板右下角，文字在右侧），Arden A1 chip（02 3 nm · 8-core CPU，指向芯片，文字在左侧），3,890 mAh battery（03 silicon-carbon · 15.0 Wh，指向电池右缘，文字在右侧）

每个标注的引线端点每帧按所指零件当前的 z 重新投影，零件上升时引线不脱开；标注文字和零件上印的字一致（芯片盖面 A1 · 3NM · 8-CORE，电池标签 3,890 mAh，锁屏通知 Battery health 100% · 3,890 mAh）；标注 4.5s 前全部淡出，盖板 4.35s 才开始上升，引线不会压在移动的盖板上；盖板、显示屏、中框淡出的同时，它们压在下面各层上的阴影一起清掉，主板近景是亮的；七层合拢从后盖开始，盖板最后，字标 8.4s 出现时手机已经向右平移约 390px，左边留给字标；9.0s 高光和 9.06s 的小回弹落在最后两层合拢（9.02s、9.14s）的时候

背景 #09090b 加径向渐变（#2a2d37 → #171920 → #0b0b0e，中心在画面 58%、40%），左上一团 10% 的琥珀光和右下一团 7% 的蓝光随方位平移；唯一强调色琥珀 #f5b04a；标注标题 Inter 600 32px 白色，副标题 JetBrains Mono 20px 白 70%，序号琥珀色；引线 1.6px，端点 4.5px 实心圆加 9px 22% 光晕；字标是 88px 琥珀圆角方块，Arden One Inter 600 156px，字距 −0.045em，标语 40px #9b9ca4；颗粒 7% 不透明度，每 3 帧换一次，暗角边缘 58%
zh.prompt: 用「爆炸图动画（Exploded View Animation）」做一支 11.8 秒、1920x1080、30fps 的深色产品片，虚构产品 Arden One（手机）。背景是径向渐变（中心 #2a2d37，经 #171920 到边缘 #0b0b0e，底色 #09090b），唯一强调色琥珀 #f5b04a，字体 Inter，标注副标题用 JetBrains Mono。用 CSS 3D：舞台 perspective 2400px，一个 rig 容器同时承担镜头（translate3d、rotateX 倾角、rotateZ 方位），里面七层手机零件叠在同一条轴上，每层 360x756px、圆角 52px，之后只改每层的 translateZ。自上而下：盖板玻璃（细亮边框）、显示屏（深蓝紫到橙色渐变的锁屏，时间 9:41、Thursday, 26 November、通知 Arden Care / Battery health 100% · 3,890 mAh）、金属中框（螺丝座、天线缝）、主板（深绿 PCB、金色走线、11 颗芯片、凸起的 A1 芯片封装 100x100px，盖面印 ARDEN A1 3NM · 8-CORE，另有基带、屏蔽罩、连接器）、电池（浅灰金属色，印 3,890 mAh、Li-ion polymer · 3.87 V · 15.0 Wh，两条橙色拉条）、无线充电线圈（铁氧体底加 12 圈铜线）、后盖（三个直径 48px 的镜头）。每层后面叠 1–7 层相距 2px 的复制层做边缘厚度，手机下方 z=−300px 铺一块 800x1200px 的径向暗影。闭合时七层 z 为 21、14、9、4、4、−6、−9px，展开时为 420、300、180、80、−20、−110、−210px，展开时下面各层按 0.16–0.58 加阴影，被上层盖着时才有。时间线：0–0.9s 从黑场淡入；七层在 1.0–1.32s 之间依次开始分开（盖板 1.0、后盖 1.05、显示屏 1.1、线圈 1.14、中框 1.2、电池 1.26、主板 1.32），每层 1.7s expo.out。镜头倾角 0.9–2.9s 从 46° 到 72°，方位 −36° 到 −38°，后退到 −230px。三个标注，SVG 引线（1.6px 琥珀线，端点 4.5px 实心圆加 9px 半透明光晕，先斜折 60px 再水平）：2.7s Cover glass（01 ceramic · 0.6 mm，指向盖板右下角，文字在右），3.0s Arden A1 chip（02 3 nm · 8-core CPU，指向芯片，文字在左），3.3s 3,890 mAh battery（03 silicon-carbon · 15.0 Wh，指向电池右缘，文字在右）；引线 0.7s 画出，标题 32px 600 白色，副标题 20px 等宽，序号琥珀色；引线端点每帧按所指零件当前的 z 重新投影；4.1–4.5s 淡出。4.35、4.45、4.55s 盖板、显示屏、中框依次淡出（0.55s）并上升 100px，它们给下层的阴影同时清掉。4.6–5.4s 镜头冲进主板：轨道枢轴移到芯片（x 93、y 93、z 80），倾角 50°，方位 −24°，推进到 +1250px，5.9s 到 +1400px（约 2.4 倍），停在主板上到 6.9s，枢轴缓移到 (200, 213, −20)；6.9–7.65s 拉出到 −200px。7.3、7.4、7.5s 三层淡回并落下（0.5s）。7.55s 起七层从后盖到盖板依次合拢，每层 1.05s 三次方缓入缓出（起点 7.55、7.63、7.71、7.79、7.87、7.97、8.09），9.14s 合完。镜头参数在关键帧之间用单调三次插值，不过冲。8.2–8.9s 手机向右平移 420px；字标 8.4s 起：88px 琥珀圆角方块升起，8.5s Arden One（156px、600、字距 −0.045em），8.75s 标语 Built from the inside out.（40px，#9b9ca4），都是 expo.out。9.0–10.3s 一道高光扫过盖板，9.06s 起镜头做一次 16px 的小回弹，倾角收到 16°，保持到片尾。最后加 7% 不透明度的颗粒（每 3 帧重取一次）和暗角。
says: 手机的零件一层一层悬在空中，层与层之间留出缝隙
引线指向芯片和电池，标出规格
盖板淡出，镜头钻到主板上，再拉出来，零件合回整机
vs: 透视叠化在同一机位把内部结构叠化成外壳，零件始终在原位；爆炸图动画把零件沿一条轴拉开，每一层单独可见，之后再合回整机。
微距拉出靠贴近局部、最后一次后拉交代整机；爆炸图动画里整机本身分成七层，镜头钻进主板后拉出，零件随后合拢。

en.title: Exploded View Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A phone's layers separate in the air with callouts, the camera dives into the logic board, then the layers close. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: A phone's cover glass, display, frame, logic board, battery, wireless coil and back glass separate in the air one by one while three callouts name the glass, the chip and the battery. The top three layers fade, the camera dives into the board and pulls out, and the seven layers close from the back up into the whole phone beside the Arden One lockup.
en.name: Exploded View Animation

body.h2: How to make a Exploded View Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Stack seven 360x756px layers on one axis in a CSS 3D stage with perspective 2400px and separate them only on z: closed at 21, 14, 9, 4, 4, -6 and -9px, open at 420, 300, 180, 80, -20, -110 and -210px. Start each layer between 1.0s and 1.32s, the cover glass first and the logic board last, and ease it over 1.7s with expo.out. Tilt the camera from 46° to 72° by 2.9s so the gaps between layers show, and pull back to -230px.

Add three callouts at 2.7s, 3.0s and 3.3s. Each leader takes 0.7s to draw, is re-projected to its part every frame and fades 4.1–4.5s. Fade the cover glass, display and frame out from 4.35s and lift them 100px, push the camera 4.6–5.4s to +1250px with its pivot on the chip, hold on the board until 6.9s and pull out to -200px by 7.65s. Bring the top three layers back from 7.3s, then close all seven from the back glass at 7.55s, each over 1.05s with cubic in-out, finished at 9.14s.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the seven layers, the callouts and the camera keys. Slide the phone 420px right over 8.2–8.9s and bring in the amber mark, the name Arden One and the tagline from 8.4s. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A phone pulled apart into floating layers, with labels for the cover glass, Arden A1 chip and 3,890 mAh battery.
faq: What is an exploded view animation?

An exploded view separates the parts of a product along one axis so each layer can be seen on its own, and a film usually puts them back together afterwards. In a launch film it shows what is inside a device and how the parts stack.
How do you make an exploded view in HTML and CSS?

Put every layer in a preserve-3d stage with the same x and y and different translateZ values, then animate only translateZ from the closed value to the open value. Stagger the start times so the layers do not move as one block, add a few copies spaced 2px apart behind each layer for edge thickness, and re-project each callout's anchor point every frame so its leader line follows the layer.

zh.name: 爆炸图动画

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做爆炸图动画
body.body:
把七层 360x756px 的零件叠在 CSS 3D 舞台的同一条轴上，舞台 perspective 2400px，只在 z 方向分开：闭合时 z 为 21、14、9、4、4、−6、−9px，展开时为 420、300、180、80、−20、−110、−210px。每层在 1.0s 到 1.32s 之间起步，盖板最先、主板最后，用 expo.out 缓动 1.7s。镜头倾角 2.9s 前从 46° 到 72°，让层与层之间的缝露出来，同时后退到 −230px。

2.7s、3.0s、3.3s 依次加三个标注。每条引线用 0.7s 画出，端点每帧按所指零件重新投影，4.1–4.5s 淡出。盖板、显示屏、中框从 4.35s 起淡出并上升 100px，镜头 4.6–5.4s 推进到 +1250px，轨道枢轴放在芯片上，停在主板上到 6.9s，7.65s 前拉出到 −200px。三层从 7.3s 淡回，七层从 7.55s 起从后盖开始合拢，每层用三次方缓入缓出 1.05s，9.14s 合完。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会做出七层零件、标注和镜头关键帧。8.2–8.9s 把手机向右平移 420px，8.4s 起带入琥珀方块、Arden One 字标和标语。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 手机拆成悬浮的几层，标注了玻璃盖板、Arden A1 芯片和 3,890 mAh 电池。
faq: 爆炸图把产品的零件沿一条轴拉开，让每一层单独可见，片子里通常随后再把零件合回去。在发布片里，它用来交代设备里面有什么、零件怎么叠。
怎么用 HTML 和 CSS 做爆炸图？
把每一层放进 preserve-3d 的舞台，x、y 相同，translateZ 不同，只对 translateZ 从闭合值到展开值做动画。各层起步时间错开，免得整叠一起动；每层后面加几个相距 2px 的复制层做边缘厚度；每帧重新投影标注的锚点，引线就能跟着零件走。
